fixed_physics_arena.scope: Independent native startups showed different battle-state digests by the first 60 steps. These captures cannot attribute the differences to the dispatch and are not used as parity or speed evidence.

same_state_native.scope: Within one frozen candidate, use each real arena physics state as identical input to the old dispatch and candidate. Alternate solver order, restore all positions and phase after each calculation. Timing includes dispatch and the entire separation solver. Testing pauses and rewinds each separation calculation before the actual tick.

immediate_baseline_control.scope: Sequential short baseline control, same native fixture source, 1280x720 Vulkan Forward+, completed between the first and second candidate runs. Host timing is variable.
